name: Kanayama Castle (Nitta Kanayama)
description: Nitta Kanayama Castle was the 15th-century mountaintop stronghold of the Nitta-aligned Iwamatsu clan, one of the largest castle sites in the Kanto plain with impressive stone walls and moats.
notes: Free open-air site with trails; the Mizusaka gate reconstruction greets visitors.
